_comment: Template for Tessie/vehicle_spec.json - real per-VIN specs the analyzer/profile scripts read (see tessie_api_common.py's load_vehicle_spec()). Copy this to Tessie/vehicle_spec.json (never committed - see .gitignore) and fill in real values from Tesla's own published spec sheet for your exact trim, plus your own curb weight/GVWR. Every field is optional - a missing section just means whatever reads it falls back to a generic default.

mass.assumed_driving_mass_note: Typically curb_weight_kg + ~150kg for a typical driver + everyday cargo. Edit directly if a different assumption fits your own usage better.
